name: Town hall
desc: The heart of the village. Trains workers and receives harvested resources.

name: Windmill
desc: Grinds 4 wheat every 8 seconds. Researches crop rotation.

name: Lumber mill
desc: Receives lumber, stone and iron. Build it by the woods to shorten the walk.
notes: A drop-off, nothing more, until per-resource drop-offs exist. Reason: the townhall is the only drop-off and hauls get long on a 96-hex island.

name: Mine
desc: Receives stone and iron. Build it by the rocks.
notes: Same as the lumber mill for now; later a per-resource drop-off and a mining speed bonus.

name: Market
notes: Gold without a deposit, slowly. Later: trade one resource for another.

name: Castle
desc: Seat of power. +10 population, trains soldiers, hard to bring down.
notes: The late-game goal to build towards. Requires masonry.

name: Wall
desc: A stone wall segment. Blocks everyone.
notes: Cheap per tile so enclosing a base is a real option, but pure stone so it forces a quarry. Available from the start: the first stone sink.

name: Gate
desc: A wall segment your own units can walk through.

name: Watchtower
desc: Sees far and shoots enemies that come within 6 tiles.
notes: Damage per second is below a soldier's, so a tower alone never wins a fight; it buys time and vision.

name: Grain field
notes: Test building: the pack model on show at 5 lumber / 3 s, no role yet (PLAN M2 table). Price it when it earns one.
